// =========================
// SETUP
// =========================
void setup() {

  Serial.begin(115200);

  // Buttons
  pinMode(BTN_LEFT, INPUT_PULLUP);
  pinMode(BTN_CENTER, INPUT_PULLUP);
  pinMode(BTN_RIGHT, INPUT_PULLUP);

  // Motor Control
  pinMode(MOTOR_PIN, OUTPUT);

  // Lopaka
  tft.init(320, 240);

  // Display TFT
  tft.begin();

  tft.setRotation(1);

  tft.fillScreen(ILI9341_BLACK);

  Serial.println("[DEBUG] System started");

  drawMain1();
  delay(3000);
}


// =========================
// MAIN LOOP
// =========================
void loop() {

  readButtons();
  
  // Lopaka
  drawAnimations();

  // Detect screen change
  if (currentScreen != previousScreen) {

    enterScreen(currentScreen);

    previousScreen = currentScreen;
  }


  // State Machine
  switch (currentScreen) {

    case SCREEN_MAIN:
      mainScreen();
      break;


    case SCREEN_CONFIG:
      configScreen();
      break;


    case SCREEN_RUN:
      runScreen();
      break;
  }
}


// =========================
// BUTTON READING
// =========================
void readButtons() {
  Screen futureState = currentState;

  if (digitalRead(BTN_CENTER) == LOW) {
    delay(50);
    if (digitalRead(BTN_CENTER) == LOW) {

      if (futureState == SCREEN_RUN) {
        sendStart();
      } else if (futureState == SCREEN_CONFIG) {
        sendConfirmation();
      }

      delay(100);
      return;
    }
  }

  if (digitalRead(BTN_RIGHT) == LOW) {
    delay(50);
    if (digitalRead(BTN_RIGHT) == LOW) {
      futureState++;
      if (futureState > SCREEN_RUN) {
        futureState = SCREEN_RUN;
        return;
      }
      goToPage(futureState);
      delay(200);
      return;
    }
  }


  if (digitalRead(BTN_LEFT) == LOW) {
    delay(50);
    if (digitalRead(BTN_LEFT) == LOW) {
      futureState--;
      if (futureState < SCREEN_CONFIG) {
        futureState = SCREEN_CONFIG;
        return;
      }
      goToPage(futureState);
      delay(200);
      return;
    }
  }
}


// =========================
// SCREEN ENTRY
// =========================
void enterScreen(Screen screen) {

  // Clear the display
  tft.fillScreen(ILI9341_BLACK);


  switch (screen) {

    case SCREEN_MAIN:

      Serial.println("[DEBUG] Entered MAIN screen");

      drawMainScreen();

      break;


    case SCREEN_CONFIG:

      Serial.println("[DEBUG] Entered CONFIG screen");

      drawConfigScreen();

      break;


    case SCREEN_RUN:

      Serial.println("[DEBUG] Entered RUN screen");

      drawRunScreen();

      break;
  }
}





// =========================
// SCREEN LOGIC
// =========================

void mainScreen() {

  drawMain2();
}


void configScreen() {

  drawConfig();
}


void runScreen() {

  drawRun();
  //getPressure();
  //getHeight();
  //getTemp();
  //getPWM();

  //updateGraphics();

}


// =========================
// NAVIGATION FUNCTIONS
// =========================

void goToPage(Screen page) {
  if (page == SCREEN_MAIN) {
    currentScreen = SCREEN_MAIN;
  } else if (page == SCREEN_RIGHT) {
    currentScreen = SCREEN_RUN;
  } else if (page == SCREEN_LEFT) {
    currentScreen = SCREEN_CONFIG;
  }
}
